name: Speed restriction for a worksite
description: A worksite between Ponte Sabato and San Felice Scalo imposes 50 km/h over 1.5 km. The restriction is in force at departure and appears in the speed profile. A second restriction, at 30 km/h, is imposed while the train is on the line.

events.text: From km 12+000 to km 12+800 speed restriction to 30 km/h for a track inspection
